purpose: Check repeated receive windows after explicit IEEE receive shutdown; ambient functional qualification, not a comparative benchmark.

captures.purpose: Repeat session 02 schedule with corrected image 03
Check both full-channel passes after the repeated-mode control succeeds

decision_rules: Preserve and verify a fresh full flash backup before flashing; restore and verify it before ending hardware work.
Require successful strict replay and independent raw derivation for every completed session.
A repeat of all-channel Wi-Fi silence after IEEE receive remains a failure of qualification even if protocol replay passes.
If that anomaly recurs, retain the failed attempt and run a fresh-boot Wi-Fi-only control before changing implementation.
Nonzero reception after transitions supports only the observed schedule; ambient changes prevent a causal or performance comparison.
Zero IEEE windows do not establish receiver fidelity; controlled peers, coded/extended BLE and RF silence remain unqualified.
Keep payloads, device identifiers, serial endpoints and unsanitized diagnostics in ignored private storage. Publish aggregates and explicitly sanitized derivatives only.
